scope: Independent research only. Keep production families, schedules, simulations, fees, frontend and deployment unchanged. Do not run EnergyPlus.
question: With existing coarse routine, family/health and EV background included, what does a prespecified six-class ECA solution represent and how does it compare to EB A-F?
sample: All 4507 valid original respondents; never select people to meet EB counts.

derivations.weekday_home_pattern: For each Monday-Friday A3 response, self or another member at home = home; explicit no one home = away. Verify mutual consistency. Summarize as all five / some one-four / none. This is weekly occupancy, not demonstrated unpredictable routine.
derivations.work_status: Preserve all original Q6b work-status categories. Do not equate casual employment with irregular daily routines.
derivations.dependent_children: A2a1 + A2a2 > 0 indicates at least one household resident under18. Background only in meaning: does not prove care duties or low DR acceptance.
derivations.health_impacts_energy_use: Direct Z7 self-report of a health condition/disability affecting energy use; no age-based imputation.
derivations.EV_home_charger: One composite categorical indicator from Q201 EV/PHEV ownership and conditional Q212 dedicated home charger: no EV/PHEV / EV with charger / EV without charger. Q200 zero vehicles implies no EV; never infer charging preferences from skipped Q213.

fit.method: Categorical latent class model using original categorical responses
fit.primary_weighting: Official survey weights normalized to mean one
fit.solver: Pinned previous research solver; EM convergence continuation with unchanged likelihood/tolerance

validation.bootstrap: 20 ordinary respondent resamples, refit with survey weights,16 starts; align by posterior overlap, not EB shares
validation.initialization: inspect final likelihood and convergence across starts
validation.holdout: 3 prespecified 80/20 splits,weighted and unweighted six-class models
sensitivity: replace raw work-status with coarse work-location arrangement

naming: Sort output classes by weighted prevalence and describe observed features. No EB labels or quotas in optimization; permit multiple, partial and absent matches.
proportions: Compare to EB584 assigned-role experimental composition only, not to a measured own-preference population. Compute gaps for stated exploratory mappings; leave unmatched roles unidentified. Do not optimize permutation to match proportions.
limits: Background detection after adding an EV/health variable is not independent validation of associated attitudes
Experienced discomfort does not equal willingness to sacrifice comfort
Automation purchase interest does not equal authorization of third-party control
Ordinary bootstrap is exploratory and does not recreate the full ECA survey design
Australian survey shares are not Chinese household prevalence
